current_r80_explanation: No distal 80% crossing is present after the peak; no extrapolation was made.
reference_r80_explanation: First distal crossing after the peak; linearly interpolated between samples.
comparison_explanation: Delta R80 not evaluable. Current: No distal 80% crossing is present after the peak; no extrapolation was made.
delta_definition: current distal R80 minus reference distal R80 (mm)
method: First distal crossing of 80% of each curve's own sampled maximum; linear interpolation between adjacent samples; no extrapolation; first sampled maximum used on ties; no automatic normalization or alignment.
coordinate_assumption: Both inputs must use the same depth origin, coordinate convention, and units; this is not verified automatically.
purpose: Educational demonstration only; not a clinical QA result or patient-specific guidance. No clinical pass/fail threshold is applied.
